properties.description: Built 2026-10-20 (reasoning.rs support_closure, reasoning_neighbours). Under one claim, reasoning_report's rests_on (and so uncited_premises and stated_foundations) lists only the terminal premises of the claim's own support; the premises of objections against it or its foundations go to `against_rests_on`; an Inference used as a premise is walked into and never listed. Trolley "Switch: turning permissible" rests on con:case-switch alone (was 15 items with 7 steps and the Footbridge judgment).
properties.name: What a claim rests on is its own support; its objections' premises are listed apart, and a step used as a premise is walked into
